text:
julian: Heads-up — Acme deal: they confirmed 10k RPS peak per minute for embeddings and chat during demos. Need capacity plan + security Q answered by EOD. @maria @evan :wave:

maria: Ack. Are those 10k RPS sustained or spike? any token estimates per request? :eyes:

julian: mostly spiky 5–10m demo bursts. Avg tokens/request ~1.2k for chat, 512 for embeddings. Peak concurrent streams ~1800. They want reserved pool + burst.

ev an: Ok. For those numbers we'd recommend Reserved GPU pool = 6 x A10040GB (or equivalent) with autoscale up to 10 for burst credits. Preheat required ~12–15m for KV cache warmup.

tara: Also depends on model variant — quantized 4-bit reduces memory so can fit more pods. Which model are they using? Proprietary or open?

julian: They'll use an open L2 model (~7B) for embeddings and an L3 chat (~13B) for chat. Prefer quantized for cost.

ev an: Rough calc: chat QPS 600 @13B -> ~4 GPUs baseline; embeddings 700 QPS -> ~2 GPUs. So baseline 6 GPUs, autoscale max 12.

maria: What about latency SLO? They asked for p95 <200ms for chat tokens.

ev an: p95 <200ms is tight on 13B for spiky load. Use low-latency routing + 2x prewarmed pods per AZ. Suggest target_rps scaling and KV cache size.

julian: Adding pricing Q: customer wants committed-discount rate for reserved pool. Can we do 18% off and burst credits at 25% of reserved? legal will want numbers.

olivia: (Legal) Need DPA + subprocessors list. Also data residency: they'd like EU-only. Confirm VPC and KMS options.

ev an: We support VPC Private with customer KMS and audit logs. For EU-only, pin model region and AZ affinity. We'll include that in the Data Room.

julian: I'm uploading the traffic profile and sample load test results to the data room: https://redwood.dataroom/acme/traffic

maria: Can someone paste an example autoscale policy I can send to customer?

ev an: Sure — send this:

```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  metric: requests_per_second
  target: 500
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  cooldown_seconds: 90
  prewarm_pods: 2
  burst_credit_percent: 25
```

ev an: Also include queue_length_based fallback:

```yaml
fallback:
  if_queue_length > 250:
    route_to: 'lower-cost-variant'
    degrade_strategy: 'truncate_response'
```

tara: Note: Prewarming KV cache: run a warmup job that streams sample prompts for ~10m per pod before go-live.

maria: Anything blocking for sales close? billing/legal/infra?

julian: Legal DPA is in progress. Billing asked for a monthly breakdown with overage rates. Infra needs a signed commitment to reserve GPUs for 12 months.

olivia: We'll fast-track DPA if they sign LOI. Also add SOC2 attestation copy to data room.

maria: I'll draft the LOI template and send to Acme. @evan can you confirm preheat time in writing?

ev an: Confirmed: recommend 12–15 minutes preheat for KV cache + 2 warmup cycles. Will post a short runbook.

deploy-bot: infra-deploy triggered for acme-reserved-pool, run id r-2024-09-12-08

julian: Thanks team. Sending customer the plan + autoscale snippet now. Will update thread with LOI sign date. :thumbsup:

maria: :rocket:
